subject: a small workbench supporting a die, a hand file laid diagonally beside it and a few shavings on the bench. A workbench with a tool working on a die surface distinguishes this from a gift box. The die remains opaque ivory with dark pips. Give each category a distinct silhouette at 96 pixels, including beside a boss emblem. Use no typography, numbers, actual card artwork, labels, price, card frame or interface overlays. Any die is an opaque ivory die with dark ink pips, no red or blue pips and no gold or glass faces. The item is a reward; gold is reserved for the specified prize accent, not a die face or a universal rarity color. Item-specific restrictions: no completed colored, gilded or glass upgrade; no floating upgrade symbol.
